description: This file defines a PHP class 'Book' responsible for generating HTML documentation pages, including navigation, table of contents, cover, and main content pages based on a directory structure and configuration. It involves methods for building navigation menus, rendering HTML components, and managing page content.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: A class responsible for generating an HTML representation of a documentation book, including navigation, table of contents, cover, individual pages, head, and body sections based on directory and configuration objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Book instance with directory tree and configuration objects.

methods.name: getStyles
methods.description: Aggregates CSS styles from theme files into a style block.

methods.name: getPageUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL identifier for a page based on its URL.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Recursively constructs navigation items from directory entries.

methods.name: renderNavigation
methods.description: Renders the navigation array into an HTML unordered list.

methods.name: generateTOC
methods.description: Creates the Table of Contents HTML fragment.

methods.name: generateCover
methods.description: Creates the cover page HTML fragment with title, tagline, and author.

methods.name: generatePages
methods.description: Assembles all pages into a single HTML fragment.

methods.name: addPage
methods.description: Adds a page with associated content to the book.

methods.name: generateHead
methods.description: Generates the HTML head section with title, meta tags, and styles.

methods.name: generateBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML body section combining cover, TOC, and pages.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML document for the book.
